exposure: Lacunar-like changes in chorion membrane on ultrasound
outcome: Maximum outer diameter of gestational mass
Maximum thickness of the chorion membrane
Longitudinal diameter of the implanting part of gestational mass in uterine lower segment
Minimum thickness of the uterine lower segment myometrium
Frequency of CSP lesion resection (open surgery or laparoscopy vs. suction curettage)
cohort: 55 patients diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) who chose to terminate pregnancy
finding: The presence of lacunar-like changes in the chorion membrane on ultrasound in early gestation was associated with a greater likelihood of complicated and worse clinical outcomes in women with CSP.
gest_age: First trimester (specific gestational age not reported)
